\synth{I went to grief counselling for about six months, which helped me deal with my dad's death and the shame about the trip. My counsellor helped me see that I was trying to find my dad in the only way I knew. I also slowly started hiking again, first in open landscapes with friends, then in forests. The first time I walked through a forest again I cried, but it was okay. I haven't taken psychedelics since and don't plan to.} & \synth{5.48} & \synth{5.48} \\
\synth{Grief counselling for about six months. It helped me accept that I couldn't have known. I eventually told my mother the truth, and she said she'd guessed and wasn't angry, which lifted a huge weight. Still avoid lakes.} & \synth{3.72} & \synth{3.72} \\

\synth{I saw a psychologist for about eight months. We worked on the claustrophobia with gradual exposure, starting with standing in a lift with the doors open, then taking one floor. That helped a lot. We also talked about my fear of death and my children, and she helped me see that the vision was about my fears, not a prophecy. I took up swimming, which helps me feel free in my body. I'm back to taking lifts, though I still don't love them.} & \synth{2.55} & \synth{2.55} \\
\synth{Reported the shop. Time.} & \synth{2.42} & \textbf{\synth{\ensuremath{-}2.42}} \\
\synth{The study team offered a debriefing and three integration sessions, which were helpful, especially because they took my experience seriously. I then saw a psychotherapist who had experience with psychedelic integration. We worked on grounding, on not ruminating about the metaphysics, and on reconnecting with my embodied life. Reading helped, particularly philosophy of mind and accounts from other people who had difficult DMT experiences. Hiking and gardening helped a lot. Physical tasks were the best anchor. My wife was patient and supportive throughout, which was probably the most important thing. I briefly considered whether another, gentler psychedelic experience might help me 'complete' it. My therapist advised against it and I'm glad I listened.} & \synth{2.35} & \textbf{\synth{\ensuremath{-}2.35}} \\
\synth{I did a fear of flying course run by an airline, plus CBT with a psychologist. My GP gave me a small amount of diazepam for the first flight after. It worked well enough.} & \synth{2.24} & \textbf{\synth{\ensuremath{-}2.24}} \\
\synth{Went to a cardiologist.} & \synth{2.17} & \textbf{\synth{\ensuremath{-}2.17}} \\
